app_info.subtitle: Explore MySQL safely
app_info.description: MySQL Bridge lets users inspect a configured MySQL schema and run single, read-only SQL queries from ChatGPT.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists tables and views without modifying the configured database.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads the user's configured MySQL database.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or make irreversible changes.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads column metadata for one table without modifying the configured database.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads the user's configured MySQL database.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or make irreversible changes.

justifications.read_only_justification: Rejects non-read-only SQL and only returns query results.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads the user's configured MySQL database.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or make irreversible changes.

test_cases.user_prompt: List the tables in my database.

test_cases.expected_output: Returns the users table columns and metadata.
Returns a single read-only query result.

test_cases.user_prompt: Count orders per customer with a CTE.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns aggregate results from one read-only statement.
Returns table and view names with their types.

negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not run a destructive query because it is read-only.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Draft a marketing email for my product.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because this request is unrelated to MySQL.
The app should not expose credentials or secrets.
